title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Software Engineer
  
  
**About Mastercard**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
Mastercard Services Access program provides access to a wide range of Mastercard’s value-added services to customers such as Issuers, Processors, or Payment Entities ranging. We help our customers to optimize revenue and control risk across all portfolios and brands.
  
  
**About The Role**
===================================
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain Java-based backend services using Spring Boot, Spring Integration, gRPC, and distributed system patterns.
* Translate business requirements and user stories into secure, efficient, and reusable software solutions.
* Contribute to technical design and architecture decisions that support performance, resiliency, maintainability, and system functionality.
* Create and maintain automated unit, functional, and integration tests to validate quality and interoperability.
* Analyze application performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimized solutions that meet service-level objectives.
* Apply secure coding practices and established engineering standards throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Conduct code reviews focused on quality, maintainability, and technical standards while mentoring junior team members.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems, complete root-cause analysis, and implement lasting fixes.
* Support operational readiness through monitoring, observability, recoverability, and production support practices.
* Manage individual priorities, deadlines, user stories, and deliverables.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, story refinement, estimation, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Partner across Engineering, Architecture, Product Management, Testing, Release Management, and Application Support to deliver quality solutions.

**About You**
===================================
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
* 5+ years of experience of Java platform engineering experience, strong expertise in Spring Boot, REST or gRPC, distributed systems, Apache Ignite/Hazelcast, Kubernetes, high-volume transaction processing, and designing resilient cloud-native service orchestration platforms. Experience in payments or financial transaction systems is highly preferred
* Proven ability to design, develop, test, and support enterprise-scale applications.
* Knowledge of software design principles, architectural patterns, domain-driven design, and non-functional requirements.
* Ability to interpret user stories and technical requirements and translate them into simple, scalable, and maintainable features.
* Advanced understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms.
* Experience creating automated unit, functional, and integration tests within continuous integration environments.
* Experience with messaging, event-driven architectures, and distributed communication technologies such as Apache Kafka or gRPC.
* Knowledge of cloud-native development using AWS, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with automated build, deployment, and continuous integration systems.
* Experience with tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, GitHub, and the Atlassian suite.
* Ability to assess system performance and implement solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across distributed applications.
* Understanding of secure coding, vulnerability prevention, and software security standards.
* Experience supporting production systems through monitoring, observability, recoverability, and operational readiness practices.
* Preferred experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build collaborative cross-functional partnerships.
* Ability to work independently in complex environments while providing technical guidance through code reviews, mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Lead discovery workshops with client business and technical teams; translate ambiguous business processes into structured conversational user flows, intent trees, fallback policies, and Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs/BRDs).

* Convert client use cases into technical specifications, detailing system integration points (CRM, ERP, ticketing), API payload requirements, database parameters, and data security constraints.

* Write, test, and refine system prompts, context instruction sets, guardrails, and tool/function call definitions to enforce deterministic bot behaviour and eliminate hallucinations.

**API Integration & Technical Debugging**

* Configure REST API webhooks between MyOperator's platform and third-party systems (e.g., Salesforce, Zoho, LeadSquared, internal databases); inspect and debug JSON request/response logs to resolve integration breakages.

**Testing, Log Analysis & Containment Iteration**

* Conduct transcript reviews of live bot interactions; build "golden conversation" test sets, run regression cycles, and optimize bot containment and task completion rates post-go-live.

**Cross-Functional Technical Alignment**

* Act as the technical voice of the customer to internal Product and Core Engineering teams—documenting platform feature gaps, API limitations, and core bugs with reproducible logs.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* **Education & Technical Foundation:**
  Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical/STEM discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc IT).
* **Total Experience:**
  2 to 5 years of experience operating as a
  **Technical Business Analyst**
  ,
  **Forward Deployed Engineer**
  ,
  **Solutions Engineer**
  ,
  **Implementation Consultant**
  , or
  **Technical Product Analyst**
  in a B2B SaaS, software, or IT services firm.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Demonstrated experience writing technical use-case documents, Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Process Flow Diagrams (Visio/Lucidchart/Miro), or API specification documents.
* **API & Data Literacy:**
  Hands-on ability to read and understand REST APIs, webhooks, JSON structures, and HTTP status codes (must be able to construct and inspect API calls via tools like Postman or cURL).
* **LLM & Conversational AI Concepts:**
  Practical, non-casual understanding of LLM parameters (system prompts, context windows, guardrails, function calling, tool use, temperature) or rule-based/NLU bot flow builders.
* **Customer-Facing Delivery Ownership:**
  Direct experience in client-facing discovery meetings, solution scoping, or delivery management with external business stakeholders.

**Good-to-Have / Preferred Signals**

* Prior hands-on experience configuring or deploying Conversational AI platforms (e.g., Dialogflow, Yellow.ai, Gupshup, Enterprise OpenAI assistants, Rasa) or WhatsApp Business API.
* Scripting or automation skills in Python, JavaScript, or no-code iPaaS tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, Zoho Flow).
* Familiarity with conversational metrics: Containment Rate, Task Completion Rate, Fallback Rate, First Response Time, and CSAT drivers.
* Exposure to CRM platforms (Zoho, Salesforce, LeadSquared) and enterprise knowledge repositories (SharePoint, Notion, SQL databases).

**Explicit Anti-Fit Criteria**

* **Non-Technical / Pure Business Backgrounds:**
  BA candidates without a technical/computer science degree or without demonstrable experience handling technical API/integration specifications.
* **Pure Coding / Internal Engineering Only:**
  Software engineers or developers seeking pure back-end/full-stack coding roles who have no interest or experience in client-facing workshops or requirement gathering.
* **Pure BPO / Non-Technical Support:**
  Candidates coming strictly from voice-process customer service, call centres, or transactional helpdesk without platform implementation experience.
* **Casual AI Users:**
  Candidates who describe standard ChatGPT text generation or copywriting as "Prompt Engineering" without experience building structured system prompts, tool interfaces, or guardrails for software applications.
* **Hands-Off Project Management:**
  Project managers or coordinators who delegate technical configuration and documentation entirely to developers without understanding the underlying technical workflows themselves.

**Target Metrics & Operational KPIs**

* **Implementation Turnaround Time (TAT):**
  % of assigned bot projects taken live within agreed timeline SOWs.
* **First-Time-Right (FTR) Quality:**
  Zero critical post-launch rework or broken workflow redesigns within 30 days of go-live.
* **Bot Performance Metrics:**
  Containment rate and task completion rate on deployed bots
* **Documentation Quality:**
  Assigned projects delivered with fully populated solution architecture diagrams, prompt packs, and API mapping documents.
